reports.title: Myanmar Living Conditions Survey 2017: Poverty Report
reports.publisher: Central Statistical Organization (CSO), Ministry of Planning and Finance (MOPF), Myanmar
reports.description: Myanmar's national household living-conditions survey, carried out by the CSO in the Ministry of Planning and Finance with technical and financial support from UNDP and the World Bank; underlies Myanmar's official poverty and living-standards statistics.

dependencies.basis: The MLCS is a comprehensive survey on how people in Myanmar live. It was carried out by the CSO in the MOPF, with technical and financial support from UNDP and the World Bank. It collects data on the occupations of people, how much income they earn and how they use this to meet the food, housing, health, education and other needs of their families.
